# GitHub forge reference validation

The forge_ref must be in the format github.com/<owner>/<repo>, and contain 'github' as the first part; otherwise, an error is raised.

To ensure correct parsing of repository owner and repo name from forge references, avoiding misconfiguration or erroneous gateway creation.

**Anchored to:**
